parsed.reason: Every fact checks out against research_notes. Short-term use being mostly safe and low doses being well tolerated are both supported. The November 2025 AHA abstract is described accurately: a year or more of use, chronic insomnia, heart failure and deaths, not peer-reviewed, no proof of cause, and poor sleep as a possible driver. Interactions and extra caution for older people are also supported. It gives no dosing regimen and no diagnosis. Pointing to a doctor or pharmacist is a fair safety judgment, not a deflect. It opens with a real answer. The register leans a little toward a health-article summary rather than a quick friend text, but it stays casual enough.
